## Summary

Continues ADR 0124 production navigation on the current main baseline. The production runtime/bake foundation and structural validation fixes are already present.

This slice exposes stable agent profile selection through the normal authoring component registry, registers the canonical `engine.nav_link` and `engine.nav_modifier` schemas for shared Inspector/CLI/MCP authoring, keeps those bake-only concepts out of runtime ECS conversion, and centralizes their canonical component IDs in the scene bridge contract.

Editor background bake, dedicated Navigation UX, stale/rebake lifecycle, path-test/debug visualization, Play/package stale gates, and final verification remain follow-up slices on this Draft PR.
